overview.text: 四 means ‘four.’ Today, an enclosing 囗 shape surrounds inner 儿-form strokes. Its ancient origin is disputed: it may be a direct numeral graph or a borrowed graph, but the evidence does not settle which.

components.text: 囗 forms the enclosing outer shape in the present graph.
儿 identifies the inner strokes in the present graph; their ancient role is unresolved.
